name: MonarchPayslipView
title: PayslipView
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of MonarchSectionHeader, MonarchDescriptionList, MonarchMoney, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchButton and androidx.compose.material3.HorizontalDivider
summary: An on-screen payslip: issuer and title, employee and period details, pay lines grouped into earnings, deductions, reimbursements and employer contributions, the gross-to-net summary and year-to-date figures.
whenToUse: To show one payslip or final settlement that payroll has already calculated, in an employee self-service app or an HR screen.
whenNotToUse: To list many payslips, use rows with MonarchMoney. For an invoice to a customer, use MonarchInvoiceView. The view never calculates pay; do that in payroll.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPayslipView(title: String, lines: List<MonarchPayslipLine>, totals: MonarchPayslipTotals, currencyCode: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, issuer: String? = null, subtitle: String? = null, status: MonarchStatusDefinition? = null, details: List<MonarchPayslipDetail> = emptyList(), yearToDate: List<MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem> = emptyList(), yearToDateTitle: String? = null, locale: Locale? = null, hideEmployerContributions: Boolean = false, downloading: Boolean = false, onDownload: (() -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchPayslipViewLabels = MonarchPayslipViewLabels())
class MonarchPayslipLine(id: String, name: String, kind: MonarchPayslipLineKind, amount: BigDecimal, note: String? = null)
enum class MonarchPayslipLineKind { Earning, Deduction, Reimbursement, Employer }
class MonarchPayslipTotals(gross: BigDecimal, deductions: BigDecimal, net: BigDecimal, reimbursements: BigDecimal? = null)

class MonarchPayslipViewLabels(earnings: String? = null, deductions: String? = null, reimbursements: String? = null, employerContributions: String? = null, grossEarnings: String? = null, totalDeductions: String? = null, netPay: String? = null, yearToDate: String? = null, noLines: String? = null, download: String? = null, downloading: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The main heading, such as "Payslip" or "Final settlement". A TalkBack heading.

options.name: lines
options.description: The calculated lines, grouped by kind in the order earnings, deductions, reimbursements, employer contributions. Empty shows "No pay lines.".

options.name: totals
options.description: Gross, deductions, optional reimbursements and net, as payroll calculated them.

options.name: currencyCode
options.description: The ISO 4217 code of every amount.

options.name: issuer
options.description: Who pays, above the title in the label style.

options.name: subtitle
options.description: A short line under the title: the period, the payslip number.

options.name: status
options.description: A status beside the title, drawn as a small MonarchStatusBadge.

options.name: details
options.description: Employee and period facts in a MonarchDescriptionList: one column on a phone, three from 640dp.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: hideEmployerContributions
options.description: Hides the employer lines, for the employee's copy where policy requires it.

options.name: downloading
options.description: The download is being prepared: the button shows its loading state and TalkBack reads "Preparing PDF".

options.name: onDownload
options.description: Shows a small secondary Download PDF button; the app makes and saves the file.

options.name: actions
options.description: More header actions after Download, such as Share.

states.name: grouped
states.description: One section per kind that has lines, each with a MonarchSectionHeader and rows of name, note and amount separated by subtle dividers.

states.name: empty
states.description: No lines (or only hidden employer lines): "No pay lines." in the muted color; the summary still shows.

states.name: reimbursements
states.description: The Reimbursements summary row shows only when totals.reimbursements is given and not zero.

states.name: employer hidden
states.description: With hideEmployerContributions the employer group is left out.

states.name: downloading
states.description: The Download button shows its spinner, is disabled and reads "Preparing PDF".

appearance: Text in the default and muted text colors on the surrounding surface, subtle dividers between lines, a default border rule over net pay in the heading style, and year-to-date tiles filled with the subtle background. The status badge carries its tone. It reads the same in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web PayslipView is an article with lists and description lists, accepts ReactNode slots and decimal or minor-unit amounts. On Android amounts are BigDecimal in major units and the status is a MonarchStatusDefinition. The parity map named LazyColumn sections; the payslip is a Column instead, so it can sit inside the screen's verticalScroll with other content, as on iOS. The web Download button is primary; here it is a small secondary button, as on iOS, so it does not compete with the screen's main action, and Monarch bundles no download icon. The headingLevel option has no Android equivalent; the title and group names are TalkBack headings. iOS ships the same MonarchPayslipView.
accessibility: The title, the group names and the year-to-date heading are TalkBack headings.
Each line is one element read as its name, note and amount; each summary row as its label and amount; each year-to-date tile as its label and amount.
The lines of a group are a traversal group named after the group.
While downloading, the Download button is disabled and its state reads "Preparing PDF".
The Download button keeps a 48dp touch target.
Names wrap and grow at font scale 2.0; right to left, names and amounts mirror.
edgeCases: Totals are never recalculated, so lines that do not add up to the totals are shown as given.
Deductions are positive numbers; no minus sign is added.
Employer lines that are hidden leave the summary unchanged.
Very long names wrap; amounts keep their own width at the end.

examples.title: Monthly payslip
examples.template:
MonarchPayslipView(
    title = {{title}},
    lines = listOf(
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.0.name}}, {{lines.0.name}}, MonarchPayslipLineKind.{{lines.0.kind|pascal}}, BigDecimal({{lines.0.amount}}), note = {{lines.0.note}}),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.1.name}}, {{lines.1.name}}, MonarchPayslipLineKind.{{lines.1.kind|pascal}}, BigDecimal({{lines.1.amount}})),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.2.name}}, {{lines.2.name}}, MonarchPayslipLineKind.{{lines.2.kind|pascal}}, BigDecimal({{lines.2.amount}}), note = {{lines.2.note}}),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.3.name}}, {{lines.3.name}}, MonarchPayslipLineKind.{{lines.3.kind|pascal}}, BigDecimal({{lines.3.amount}})),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.4.name}}, {{lines.4.name}}, MonarchPayslipLineKind.{{lines.4.kind|pascal}}, BigDecimal({{lines.4.amount}})),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.5.name}}, {{lines.5.name}}, MonarchPayslipLineKind.{{lines.5.kind|pascal}}, BigDecimal({{lines.5.amount}})),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.6.name}}, {{lines.6.name}}, MonarchPayslipLineKind.{{lines.6.kind|pascal}}, BigDecimal({{lines.6.amount}})),
    ),
    totals = MonarchPayslipTotals(
        gross = BigDecimal({{totals.gross}}),
        deductions = BigDecimal({{totals.deductions}}),
        net = BigDecimal({{totals.net}}),
        reimbursements = BigDecimal({{totals.reimbursements}}),
    ),
    currencyCode = {{currency}},
    issuer = {{issuer}},
    subtitle = {{subtitle}},
    status = MonarchStatusDefinition({{status.label}}, {{status.tone|tone}}),
    details = listOf(
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.0.label}}, {{details.0.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.1.label}}, {{details.1.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.2.label}}, {{details.2.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.3.label}}, {{details.3.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.4.label}}, {{details.4.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.5.label}}, {{details.5.value}}),
    ),
    yearToDate = listOf(
        MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.0.label}}, BigDecimal({{yearToDate.0.amount}})),
        MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.1.label}}, BigDecimal({{yearToDate.1.amount}})),
        MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.2.label}}, BigDecimal({{yearToDate.2.amount}})),
        MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.3.label}}, BigDecimal({{yearToDate.3.amount}})),
    ),
    yearToDateTitle = {{yearToDateTitle}},
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    labels = MonarchPayslipViewLabels(download = {{download}}),
    onDownload = {},
)
